scientific_rule: A revealed holdout is permanently consumed. A failure may not be converted into a tuning set for a model that is then re-tested on the same year. Any post-failure mechanism change must be independently justified outside the failed outcomes and evaluated on a new sealed year.

holdouts.allowed_future_role: historical/training information only after the failure has been preserved; never a confirmatory holdout again
descriptive or training/history only; cannot support a new anti-overfit confirmation claim
one prospective confirmatory use against the preregistered independent source family; after reveal this year/source pair is permanently consumed

next_required_validation_surface.rule: Use a genuinely new validation surface whose target labels were not available to mechanism development. Acceptable routes are a newly acquired independent Afghanistan event-measurement source with a frozen construct mapping, or a new external conflict/case. Before any target labels are inspected, create a year/source-specific exposure certificate and seal the model/protocol.
